maddeler.e:
أسلنطح (form IIIq)
# أَسْلَنْطِحُ (ʔaslanṭiḥu) /ʔas.lan.tˤi.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# أَسْلَنْطِحَ (ʔaslanṭiḥa) /ʔas.lan.tˤi.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# أَسْلَنْطِحْ (ʔaslanṭiḥ) /ʔas.lan.tˤiħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
